newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish troops say 69 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkish troops say 69 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish security forces have killed 69 Kurdish rebels for the loss of nine soldiers in separate clashes in four southeast provinces over the past few days, the emergency rule governor's office said on Tuesday.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old war between Turkish forces and Kurdish rebels fighting for independence or autonomy.
